# MyCCS Copilot Instructions

Use the repo guidance in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the source of truth for this workspace.

## Quick Rules

- Keep changes Expo-compatible and centered on React Native patterns.
- Follow the Jira-linked branching and merge rules in the docs under [docs/jira](../docs/jira).
- Keep frontend changes and Supabase migration changes together when schema or RLS changes are involved.
- Update or add tests when behavior changes.
- Keep the AI orchestration scaffold in `ai/` and the custom agent prompts in `.github/agents/` aligned when workflow behavior changes.
